Plan P1.1: producer-generated synthetic packets matching the v7 canvas boards: (a) 'The forgotten bag' (Main/SourceReading/RevealReturn/Narrow: 10 recall rows incl. one failed and one untimed, 12 events in 3 scenes, tied E02/E07 alternative, one zero-mass fill); (b) 'Silent River' (173 units x 50 scenes incl. untimed and unanchored units, decode-bound and decode-filled origins, external-dominant rows) for FilmScale/TimeVoyage and the Voyage workshop (storyatlas4s docs/delivery/voyage-workshop/data.js gives its producer rules). Written through the public codecs next to WorkspaceFixtures (Bell); decode + validate; digests and expected answers recorded.
Requested by StoryAtlas (storyatlas4s docs/plans/2026-09-25-north-star-plan.md, owner-approved 2026-09-25). Atlas draws only supplied structure (ADR 0002 D4); until this lands Atlas shows an explicit unavailable state.
set.title: [Fixtures] Forgotten-bag and Silent River workspace packets for design replication
